invariants.name: canonical authority is unique
invariants.condition: exactly one canonical_narrative object with authority=canonical

invariants.name: target duration range valid
invariants.condition: duration_min_sec <= duration_max_sec

invariants.name: source span ordered
invariants.condition: every SourceSpan.end >= SourceSpan.start

invariants.name: explicit provenance
invariants.condition: every explicit semantic item has non-empty evidence

invariants.name: event refs resolve
invariants.condition: transition from_event/to_event exist in StoryIR.events

invariants.name: hard meaning coverage
invariants.condition: every hard assertion and hard obligation is represented or explicitly text-covered

invariants.name: scene continuity
invariants.condition: scene[i].state_out is compatible with scene[i+1].state_in

invariants.name: scene refs resolve
invariants.condition: every ShotIR.scene_id exists in SceneBundleIR

invariants.name: obligation refs resolve
invariants.condition: every shot obligation exists in MeaningSpec

invariants.name: asset refs resolve
invariants.condition: every ShotIR.asset_ref exists in AssetManifest

invariants.name: asset consumers resolve
invariants.condition: every AssetManifest.consumer exists in ShotBundleIR

invariants.name: capability hard match
invariants.condition: assigned backend supports every required task/control/limit

invariants.name: hard invariant control
invariants.condition: material hard invariant cannot rely only on uncontrolled stochastic generation

invariants.name: timeline frame exact
invariants.condition: all clip starts/durations are integral non-negative frame counts

invariants.name: low-confidence fail-closed
invariants.condition: low-confidence hard semantic check cannot be PASS

invariants.name: single output owner
invariants.condition: each output kind has one stage producer

invariants.name: stage graph acyclic
invariants.condition: on_pass graph has no cycle and all stages reachable from S00

invariants.name: failure codes registered
invariants.condition: all stage/substep failure codes exist in central catalog

invariants.name: bounded retry
invariants.condition: repair attempts never exceed StageContract.max_repairs

invariants.name: content identity stable
invariants.condition: artifact hash is computed from canonical content; execution timestamps are excluded

invariants.name: lineage acyclic
invariants.condition: artifact parent graph cannot contain self/cycles

invariants.name: package only verified master
invariants.condition: S12 cannot run unless S11 hard_gate_status == PASS
